scope: Hash-bound R14/AC1014 file-header locator and AcDb:Header envelope accounting for one external local sample; no parser behavior was changed.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
rules: R13-R15 section-locator record count selects the documented header CRC XOR value; count 5 uses 0x3CC4.
The file-header CRC is followed by the 16-byte 0x95A04E... sentinel.
The R13-R15 AcDb:Header section contains a begin sentinel, declared byte count and data, 16-bit CRC, then end sentinel.

source.provenanceLimit: The file is from a local ACadSharp sample checkout; its producer and source-generation provenance were not established in this audit. It is not a repository fixture.

fileHeader.crcMethod: Independent bytewise implementation of ODA §2.14.1 reflected 0xA001 table update, seed 0, then the §3.2 count-specific XOR.

headerSection.crcMethod: Independent bytewise implementation of ODA §2.14.1 over section bytes 16 through 456 inclusive, seed 0xC0C1.

implementationObservation.observation: The current AC1014 reader reports section 0 at offset 13431, size 475; declared size 437; payload end 457; trailer end 475; unclaimed bytes 0; and operationSucceeded=true, legacyError=0. The overall conversion exits 1 after three unrelated entity/block warnings, so this is only a HEADER/file-locator result.

limits: One unverified-provenance source does not establish AC1014 producer breadth or whole-drawing support.
Other R13-R15 section records, optional templates, and source profiles are outside this bounded header-section accounting result.
No sample or derived DWG/DXF fixture was added to the repository.
